name: Nyx Hollow
title: Night Edge
description: A void-step assassin. She vanishes through her own silhouette and reappears with a blade of dusk.
source_description: Female fighter, lean, black hair, violet cloak, cunning personality, shadow-based powers.
special_desc: A teleporting cross-up slash that beats blocking if spaced late.
ultimate_desc: Floods the lane with void edges.
